status.label: PUP
status.shortComment: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.
status.longComment: Charbonnet sits on the reserve/PUP list due to the left ACL tear he suffered in the divisional round on Jan. 17, meaning he must miss at least the first four games of the season. However, new rules for players on reserve/PUP allow players to practice as soon as Week 3 with the potential to return Week 5. If Charbonnet gets back on the practice field during Week 4 prep, he conceivably could return to action the next week, though the Seahawks likely will take a cautious approach considering the severity of the aforementioned injury.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Seahawks placed Bradford (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
status.longComment: Bradford missed the team's Week 2 win over the Cardinals and will now be forced to sit out at least another four games before he's eligible to return. In his absence, Christian Haynes will likely serve as Seattle's starting right guard.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Pili (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Cardinals, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
status.longComment: Pili has entered the league's concussion protocol and will miss the rest of Sunday's game. The defensive tackle will need to progress through the five-step protocol and be cleared by an independent neurologist to return to the field. Rylie Mills is now the sole reserve defensive tackle available to the Seahawks in Sunday's game.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Okada (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Commanders, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
status.longComment: Okada has not practiced since suffering a hamstring issue in the lead-up to the Seahawks' Week 1 win over the Patriots. AJ Finley will likely start at strong safety opposite Rodney Thomas at free safety, who is filling in for Julian Love (calf). With both starters out, coach Mike MacDonald will likely lean even more heavily on star slot cornerback Nick Emmanwori.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Love (calf) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Commanders, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
status.longComment: Love had his calf tighten up on him during Thursday's practice, and the safety was unable to get back on the field for Friday's session. With Love ruled out ahead of Sunday's game, Rodney Thomas is set to start at free safety opposite AJ Finley at strong safety. Both defensive backs are filling in, leaving the back end of Seattle's defensive unit weaker for Week 3.
